mapper.sql: id, merchant_id, claimant_member_id, contact_name, contact_phone, claim_statement, submit_request_id, submit_fingerprint, status, audit_actor_id, audit_reason, audit_request_id, audit_fingerprint, version, submitted_at, audited_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: select from merchant_claim where claimant_member_id = #{claimantMemberId} and submit_request_id = #{requestId} for update
select from merchant_claim where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and status in ('PENDING','APPROVED') for update
select from merchant_claim where id = #{id} for update
select from merchant_claim where claimant_member_id = #{claimantMemberId} order by create_time desc, id desc
select from merchant_claim where status = 'PENDING' order by submitted_at asc, id asc limit #{limit}
select id, claim_id as claimId, proof_type as proofType, asset_id as assetId from merchant_claim_proof where claim_id = #{claimId} order by id
mapper.insert: insert into merchant_claim (merchant_id, claimant_member_id, contact_name, contact_phone, claim_statement, submit_request_id, submit_fingerprint, status, version, submitted_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{merchantId}, #{claimantMemberId}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{statement}, #{submitRequestId}, #{submitFingerprint}, #{status}, #{version}, #{submittedAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
insert into merchant_claim_proof (claim_id, proof_type, asset_id, create_time) values (#{claimId}, #{proofType}, #{assetId}, now())
mapper.update: update merchant_claim set status = #{nextStatus}, audit_actor_id = #{actorId}, audit_reason = #{reason}, audit_request_id = #{requestId}, audit_fingerprint = #{fingerprint}, audited_at = now(), version = version + 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = #{expectedStatus} and version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: select id, actor_id, request_id, request_fingerprint, action, create_time from merchant_claim_batch_command where actor_id = #{actorId} and request_id = #{requestId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into merchant_claim_batch_command (actor_id, request_id, request_fingerprint, action, create_time) values (#{actorId}, #{requestId}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{action}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, batch_command_id, claim_id, success, result_code, result_message, current_status from merchant_claim_batch_result where batch_command_id = #{batchCommandId} and claim_id = #{claimId}
select id, batch_command_id, claim_id, success, result_code, result_message, current_status from merchant_claim_batch_result where batch_command_id = #{batchCommandId} order by id
mapper.insert: insert into merchant_claim_batch_result (batch_command_id, claim_id, success, result_code, result_message, current_status, create_time) values (#{batchCommandId}, #{claimId}, #{success}, #{code}, #{message}, #{currentStatus}, now())
